name: Sample Properties
abstract: OMS alignment: implements the ISO 19156:2023 (OGC Topic 20 / O&M 3.0) `sam-cpt/Sample` requirement class for `sosa:Sample`. This building block defines the set of properties for a SOSA Sample - a feature which is intended to be representative of a FeatureOfInterest on which Observations may be made, typically the result of a Sampling.
